title: HR Executive
summary: Support hiring, employee coordination and day-to-day people operations.
responsibilities: Coordinate interview schedules and communicate with candidates.
Support onboarding, employee records and HR documentation.
Work with teams to keep people processes organised and responsive.
qualifications: Good organisation and attention to detail.
Interest in recruitment and employee experience.

title: Mobile/Web App Developer
summary: Develop useful web and mobile experiences for Srisun products and client projects.
responsibilities: Build and maintain responsive web or mobile app features.
Collaborate with design and engineering on user-focused solutions.
Test, improve and document product functionality.
qualifications: Knowledge of app or web development fundamentals.
Experience with JavaScript or a mobile development framework.
A practical approach to debugging and teamwork.

title: Digital Marketing Interns
summary: Help plan and deliver digital campaigns, content and audience research.
responsibilities: Assist with social, email and web marketing activities.
Research topics, audiences and campaign performance.
Coordinate content and campaign tasks with the team.
qualifications: Interest in digital marketing and content.
Good writing, research and communication skills.

title: Cybersecurity Interns
summary: Learn security practices while supporting research, reviews and awareness activities.
responsibilities: Assist with security research and basic assessments.
Document findings and help track remediation tasks.
Support security awareness and internal best practices.
qualifications: Foundational knowledge of networking or information security.
Interest in learning security tools and methods.

title: AI Engineer Trainee
summary: Contribute to AI prototypes and automation workflows while growing your engineering skills.
responsibilities: Support development and evaluation of AI-powered features.
Work with data, APIs and automation workflows.
Document experiments and share learnings with the team.
qualifications: Programming fundamentals in Python or JavaScript.
Interest in machine learning, generative AI or automation.

title: Full Stack Engineer
summary: Build end-to-end product features across frontend, backend and data services.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain frontend and backend application features.
Design and integrate APIs and data models.
Work with the team to improve reliability, performance and quality.
qualifications: Experience with frontend and backend web development.
Knowledge of APIs, databases and version control.
Ability to collaborate and solve problems across the stack.
